question: The Indian National Congress passed Purna Swaraj resolution in 1929 under the presidentship of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Purna Swaraj resolution** was passed on **December 31, 1929, **during **the Lahore session of the Indian National Congress**.
 
• It declared that complete independence or Purna Swaraj was the goal of the Indian National Congress.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was the president of the Indian National Congress in 1929, and he hoisted the Indian national flag on January 26, 1930, to commemorate Purna Swaraj Day.
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** was not the president of the Indian National Congress in 1929, but he was the driving force behind the resolution and played a crucial role in its adoption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lala Lajpat Rai was a prominent Indian nationalist and freedom fighter who was known as the Lion of Punjab.
 
• He was a member of the Indian National Congress and participated in several agitations against British rule. However, he passed away in 1928, a year before the Purna Swaraj resolution was passed.
 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel was also a prominent Indian nationalist and freedom fighter who played a key role in India's struggle for independence. He was a member of the Indian National Congress and served as its president in 1931.
 
• However, he was not the president of the Indian National Congress in 1929 when the Purna Swaraj resolution was passed.
